d.d: Initialism of network on a chip.
Either of the two grooves in a bow that hold the bowstring.
The notch at the rear of an arrow that fits on the bowstring.
The upper fore corner of a boom sail or trysail.
To fit (an arrow) against the bowstring of a bow or crossbow.
To cut a nock in (usually in an arrow's base or the tips of a bow).
Fit the arrow to your bowstring.
Of a person, creature, group, or species, primarily active during the night.
Of an occurrence, taking place at night, nightly.
A person or creature that is active at night.
A device for telling the time at night, rather like a sundial but read according to the stars.
A work in a genre of piano music of moderate tempo with a highly-decorated, improvisatory melody.
A work of art relating or dedicated to the night.
